title: Ticker — Session detail
description: Short-range view over raw observations. Pick a window from the Sessions table on the Overview dashboard, or zoom straight in here.

list.name: metric
list.label: Extra metric
list.description: Which secondary metric the bottom panel shows.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.value), 1) AS "Avg"
FROM observations o JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
WHERE m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm'
  AND o.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  AND o.ts <  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'

panels.title: Beats captured
panels.description: RR intervals in range — one row per heartbeat.

targets.rawQueryText:

FROM observations o JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
WHERE m.name = 'rr_interval_ms'
  AND o.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  AND o.ts <  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Raw samples straight from observations — no bucketing, so this is what the strap actually reported.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', o.ts) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time,
       o.value AS bpm
FROM observations o JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
WHERE m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm'
  AND o.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  AND o.ts <  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: $metric
panels.description: Any other metric over the same window. RR intervals are one point per heartbeat.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', o.ts) AS INTEGER) * 1000
         + CAST(strftime('%f', o.ts) * 1000 AS INTEGER) % 1000 AS time,
       o.value AS "$metric"
FROM observations o JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
WHERE m.name = '$metric'
  AND o.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  AND o.ts <  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
ORDER BY time
